messages.subject: adding cmd opts to mcmc
parts:
I'm going to be making some changes on stan::mcmc
to add the command-line options and to simplify all
the code.

The more I see of C++ idioms, the more I
like the idea of making something like a sampler
a concept rather than a subclass.

Given all the overlapping functionality, I think
it makes more sense at this point to just put
everything into one configurable NUTS class.

I hope to get all the changes done today.
I'll let you know when it's safe to touch
again.

- Bob
